body.x: Spatial extended reality (XR) technology enterprise NEWJAK Co., Ltd. (CEO Haehyun Jung) announced that its proprietary Autonomous Spatial Intelligence Platform, SPACEON, has been named a CES Innovation Awards 2027 Honoree in the Artificial Intelligence category by the Consumer Technology Association (CTA). The recognition marks the company’s third consecutive year of accolades at the world's largest technology exhibition, bringing its cumulative total to four CES Innovation Awards following dual honors for X-RUNNER in 2025 across Content & Entertainment and Metaverse, and recognition for SPORTRACK in 2026 within XR & Spatial Computing.

The achievement comes amid record competition, with CTA evaluating nearly 4,000 entries across 37 product categories for CES 2027—a 10% overall increase in submissions, led by a 15% surge in the Artificial Intelligence field. Departing from conventional XR systems that require participants to wear bulky headsets, external sensors, or handheld controllers, SPACEON transforms physical architectural spaces into autonomous environments that perceive, interpret, and adapt dynamically to human presence.

body.cap: Haehyun Jung, CEO of NEWJAK | Image Provided by NEWJAK

body.x: Developed in 2026, SPACEON operates via five integrated artificial intelligence modules: SENSE, MODEL, ADAPT, SYNC, and LEARN. Utilizing a LiDAR sensor array paired with a real-time Unreal Engine 5 rendering pipeline, the system tracks up to 15 individuals simultaneously across a 50-square-meter footprint without markers, maintaining a positional accuracy of ±3 cm. The platform completes AI inference in 30 milliseconds and achieves an end-to-end sensing-to-response latency of 48.2 milliseconds. This enables instant content calibration based on individual user profiles. For instance, when detecting a child with a shorter reach and slower reaction times, the platform automatically enlarges interactive targets by 35%, contracts the active interaction perimeter by 25%, and reduces game speed by 20%, assigning distinct roles and objectives to different participants who share the same room.

Engineered as a foundational operating infrastructure rather than single-use content, SPACEON allows multipurpose venue utilization where educational modules, media art exhibitions, retail showrooms, drone training simulations, and gaming formats run seamlessly on shared projection and compute hardware. The underlying architecture was developed through five major South Korean national R&D projects, including the Ministry of SMEs and Startups’ Super-Gap Startup Project, the Korea Creative Content Agency (KOCCA) talent initiatives, and global cooperative R&D programs under the Korea Technology and Information Promotion Agency for SMEs (TIPA). NEWJAK holds registered patents in the United States, Japan, and China, has received a grant decision in Europe, and has filed a PCT international patent application for SPACEON.

body.cap: Promotional banner for NEWJAK's SPACEON | Image Provided by NEWJAK

body.x: The enterprise has demonstrated widespread operational reliability across South Korean defense, municipal, and educational facilities, deploying device-free XR installations at the Korea Army Training Center, Jihyo Elementary School in Goyang, the Chuncheon Idea Library, and the Hanam Mental Health Welfare Center, as well as a 20-school educational rollout across Incheon. In international markets, NEWJAK captured the Smart Glasses Core Technology Innovation Award of the Year for SPORTRACK at the Shenzhen International AI+AR Smart Glasses Industry Expo 2026 in China and executed an MOU with UAE-based MetaLife Metaverse for Middle Eastern expansion.

NEWJAK will present live demonstrations of SPACEON at CES 2027, from January 6 to 9, at the Venetian Expo, Halls A-D (Booth 50765), as part of the Jeonnam-Gwangju Special Metropolitan City Pavilion. Haehyun Jung, CEO of NEWJAK, stated that SPACEON marks a transition from device-centric XR toward human-centric spatial intelligence where environments perceive and respond to human behavior, noting that the enterprise will actively leverage its third consecutive CES honor to scale licensing and distribution partnerships across educational, cultural, and commercial venue operators throughout North America and Europe.
